title: Minimum Window Subarray Containing All Distinct Elements
statement:
Given an array of N integers, find the length of the shortest contiguous subarray that contains all distinct elements present in the full array.

In other words, find the minimum-length window [l, r] such that the set of distinct elements in A[l..r] equals the set of all distinct elements in A.

Use a sliding window (two pointers) with a frequency map to solve in O(N).

Return the length of the minimum such window.
inputFormat:
Line 1: a single integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the shortest subarray containing all distinct elements.

examples.explanation: All distinct elements are {1,2,3}. Window [2,3,1] (indices 1-3) has length 3 and contains all three.
Shortest window with {1,2,3}: any of the windows [1,2,3] of length 3.
